notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (pp6-7; Total column p7). Business-type lines from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, enterprise Total column (pp10-11); internal service funds excluded (combining statements pp26-27 not recorded). Business-type receipts total = operating + nonoperating revenues (computed); disbursements total 14,585,430 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses + interest expense. Business 'Other revenue' 19,788 is Miscellaneous general revenue on the Statement of Activities (p3), not charges for services, so it stays other. ending_cash = Total Governmental Funds Cash and cash equivalents 3,589,612 (p5); restricted cash 6,680,646 and county treasurer cash 267,536 not included. Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), each line by Governmental/Business-type column; internal balances net to zero. Detail: budgetary comparison schedules (budget basis) for General, Street, Sales Tax, Debt Service, Redevelopment and Airport funds (pp16-21); General Fund 'Loan proceeds' 2,295,964 is printed inside Total resources (recorded as revenue Loan Proceeds); Redevelopment 'Bond/loan proceeds' (0 actual) as other financing printed in revenue. Debt Service Fund schedule prints no total line. Nonmajor combining statement (pp22-25) recorded per fund column (15 funds; Nuisance Cleanup has no activity), matching the FY2024 extraction. TIF proceeds as property tax; Enhanced Employment Area tax as other taxes (as FY2024). Read pages 1-27 of 27
